Welcome to 38141 Seneca Circle, a custom 2019 estate on 2.27 acres in the heart of Temecula Wine Country. The main residence offers 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and 3,050 square feet, joined by a brand new 1,705 square foot guest house completed in 2025, for 4,755 square feet of combined living space across two homes. The great room opens with 16 foot ceilings, a floor to ceiling rock fireplace, and oversized patio doors framing sweeping views across the vineyards and valley. At the center of the home, a 48 inch Italian dual fuel range anchors a kitchen built for real cooking, paired with a knotty alder island in leathered granite, custom cabinetry throughout, and an oversized butler pantry. Every bedroom has its own bathroom, and the primary suite features a large walk in shower, separate soaking tub, dual vanity, and custom walk in closet. Two oversized garages include EV charging and a full workshop.

Outdoor living centers on a sports pool with three waterfalls, programmable lighting, Baja entry, and submerged seating, wrapped on two sides by a putting green and expansive stamped concrete decking. The covered outdoor kitchen features a Lion grill, pizza oven, refrigerator, and bar seating, while the back patio is wired for a spa, speakers, and television.

The 2025 guest house lives as a home of its own, with a private bedroom suite, a full second bathroom, and an open loft that works beautifully as a second sleeping space, office, or retreat. Soaring ceilings and hand scraped French white oak floors set the tone, along with a one of a kind island of old growth burl redwood set in epoxy. Its own septic, HVAC, electrical panel, and covered parking make it ideal for multigenerational living, guests, or income.

Fully paid solar sits atop the RV barn, which offers concrete flooring, cedar siding, and full hookups, with a second RV hookup on its own driveway beside the main residence. Low water landscaping keeps maintenance minimal, and the views reach in every direction across the Temecula Valley, with sunrises, sunsets, and hot air balloons drifting past. No HOA, minutes from the De Portola Wine Trail, and rarely available in this pocket of wine country.

results.remarks: SPLISH SPLASH!! SUMMER IS FAR FROM OVER~THERE IS STILL TIME TO OWN AND ENJOY THIS STUNNING POOL HOME! With over $186,000 in upgrades including the opulent pool, your own private resort awaits! This luxurious remodeled Rancho Highlands home features a show stopping backyard pool and spa designed for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying the best of the Temecula lifestyle. The sparkling pool features a raised spa, dual cascading water features, beautiful Spanish tile, and a generous shallow sun shelf—perfect for lounging in the water on warm summer days. Lush bougainvillea and mature greenery surround the pool, creating an elegant landscape and private setting that feels like your own secluded retreat. The expansive patio and Alumawood patio cover provide plenty of room for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing poolside. The peaceful, tree-filled hillside adds to the sense of privacy and provides a stunning natural backdrop for this exceptional outdoor space. Inside, this completely remodeled home offers the perfect complement to its exceptional outdoor living space. A PAID-FOR 22-panel solar system adds tremendous value and energy efficiency. The entry welcomes you with beautiful laminate wood flooring, soaring ceilings, upscale light fixtures, abundant windows, and natural light. The updated kitchen features fresh white cabinetry, granite countertops, farmhouse sink and stainless-steel appliances. A beautiful fireplace creates a warm and inviting gathering space, while a convenient half bath and oversized laundry room with utility sink complete the downstairs. Upstairs, the laminate wood flooring continues throughout the hallway and into the four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The updated primary bathroom features custom tile showers and granite countertops. Located in the highly desirable Rancho Highlands, residents enjoy an array of resort-style community amenities including a pool, spa, wading pool, playgrounds, tennis and sports courts, picnic areas with BBQs, and walking trails. Ideally situated in the heart of Temecula, you are just minutes from Old Town Temecula, The Promenade, Temecula Wine Country, the Temecula Duck Pond, Pechanga, dining, shopping, and convenient freeway access for commuters. results.remarks: Welcome to an exceptional single-story home in the highly sought-after Morgan Hill community. Offering 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and approximately 2,056 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this home combines comfort, functionality, and some of the most spectacular views Temecula has to offer. Perched to capture sweeping panoramic views, this home delivers something truly rare: amazing valley and mountain views with spectacular mountain sunsets, followed by the glow of city lights across the valley below — a must see. Morning coffee as the mountains catch first light, evening on the patio as the sun drops behind the ridgeline and the valley lights come alive — here, the scenery becomes part of everyday life. Inside, the open-concept floor plan creates an inviting flow centered around the spacious kitchen and living areas — perfect for everyday living and entertaining alike. The generously sized primary suite provides a private retreat with ample space to unwind and all the amenities you could want, including dual closets for exceptional storage and convenience. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies. Beyond the home, Morgan Hill offers an outstanding collection of resort-style amenities designed for an active and relaxed Southern California lifestyle. Residents enjoy a beautiful clubhouse, sparkling pool and spa, sports courts, and multiple parks and gathering spaces — many with their own beautiful views and peaceful surroundings. And you're just minutes from Temecula Wine Country and Old Town, where fall brings harvest festivals, hot air balloons, and the valley's perfect autumn weather — warm days and cool evenings made for sunset views from your own backyard. With its desirable single-story design, spacious interiors, exceptional primary suite, and truly captivating mountain, valley, and city light views, this Morgan Hill home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of South Temecula living.

Perched to capture sweeping panoramic views, this home delivers something truly rare: amazing valley and mountain views with spectacular mountain sunsets, followed by the glow of city lights across the valley below — a must see. Morning coffee as the mountains catch first light, evening on the patio as the sun drops behind the ridgeline and the valley lights come alive — here, the scenery becomes part of everyday life. Inside, the open-concept floor plan creates an inviting flow centered around the spacious kitchen and living areas — perfect for everyday living and entertaining alike. The generously sized primary suite provides a private retreat with ample space to unwind and all the amenities you could want, including dual closets for exceptional storage and convenience. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies. Beyond the home, Morgan Hill offers an outstanding collection of resort-style amenities designed for an active and relaxed Southern California lifestyle. Residents enjoy a beautiful clubhouse, sparkling pool and spa, sports courts, and multiple parks and gathering spaces — many with their own beautiful views and peaceful surroundings. And you're just minutes from Temecula Wine Country and Old Town, where fall brings harvest festivals, hot air balloons, and the valley's perfect autumn weather — warm days and cool evenings made for sunset views from your own backyard. With its desirable single-story design, spacious interiors, exceptional primary suite, and truly captivating mountain, valley, and city light views, this Morgan Hill home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of South Temecula living.

results.remarks:
Discover the perfect blend of comfort, style, and breathtaking views in Temecula's highly sought-after Vintage Hills community. Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers 2,328 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space on an impressive 13,068-square-foot lot—providing endless possibilities to create the backyard oasis you've always imagined.

Freshly updated with modern flooring, designer lighting, and contemporary paint, this move-in-ready home welcomes you with soaring vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and an open, airy floor plan that perfectly balances elegance and everyday living. The remodeled kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a center island, and a charming breakfast nook, flowing effortlessly into the inviting family room—ideal for entertaining or relaxing with family. Formal living and dining rooms provide sophisticated spaces for holidays and special gatherings.

A standout feature is the spacious main-level primary suite, offering exceptional convenience and privacy. This peaceful retreat includes a generous walk-in closet and a spa-inspired atmosphere designed for rest and relaxation. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms plus a versatile loft, perfect for a home office, media room, playroom, or flexible living space.

Step outside to an expansive backyard where panoramic vineyard views create a truly unforgettable setting. Watch colorful hot air balloons drift gracefully across the Temecula sky while enjoying your morning coffee or evening sunsets. The oversized yard is enhanced by mature fruit trees, adding beauty, shade, and the simple pleasure of harvesting fresh fruit right from your own backyard. With ample room for a custom pool, outdoor kitchen, or personalized outdoor retreat, this exceptional property offers incredible potential for outdoor living and entertaining.

Additional highlights include a three-car garage with abundant storage and access to the exceptional Vintage Hills community amenities, including two resort-style pools and spas, tennis and basketball courts, a clubhouse, playgrounds, and scenic walking trails.

Ideally located just minutes from award-winning schools, premier shopping and dining, Temecula's world-famous wineries, and convenient freeway access, this exceptional home offers the very best of Southern California living in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods.

results.remarks: STUNNING SINGLE-STORY HOME IN THE HIGHLY DESIRABLE SOMMERS BEND COMMUNITY!!! Offering 3 bedrooms plus an office and 3 bathrooms, this beautifully appointed home immediately impresses with its exceptional curb appeal, drought-tolerant landscaping, and inviting oversized front porch. Inside, sophisticated modern finishes combine with an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Soaring ceilings and an expansive great room create an inviting sense of space, complemented by gorgeous dark wood cabinetry and accents, while the kitchen features quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, soft-close cabinetry, and sleek Café appliances with smart-home functionality. A Simplifire fireplace anchors the living area, while a dramatic set of double sliding doors opens directly to the California Room. The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat with a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom featuring a generous walk-in shower, dual vanities, and modern cabinetry, along with a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms provide plenty of space for family and guests, while the dedicated office offers the perfect work-from-home space. A separate laundry room adds convenience and functionality. Step outside to a low-maintenance backyard featuring lush turf, creating an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the Southern California lifestyle. Custom window coverings, solar panels, and modern smart-home features add comfort, convenience, and efficiency to this exceptional home. Located in the sought-after Sommers Bend community, residents enjoy an exceptional collection of amenities designed for an active Southern California lifestyle, including parks, walking and biking trails, playgrounds, and sports facilities. The community's Sports Ranch offers baseball and soccer fields, basketball courts, picnic areas, BBQs, and a playground, creating plenty of opportunities for recreation and gathering. With its modern comfort, seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living, and community amenities, this exceptional single-story home truly has it all.

results.remarks:
Welcome to Harveston, one of Temecula’s most desirable and sought-after communities, known for its picturesque lake, exceptional amenities, and inviting neighborhood atmosphere. Ideally located in North Temecula with convenient access to both Temecula and Murrieta, this beautifully updated home combines comfortable living with the exceptional lifestyle Harveston is known for.

Step inside to find upgraded flooring and trim, fresh designer-inspired paint, plantation shutters, and charming built-in beadboard shelving that adds both character and functionality. The kitchen features granite countertops and a large butcher-block island, creating generous space for meal preparation, entertaining, and everyday gatherings. French doors add to the home's character and indoor-outdoor feel.

Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a walk-in shower, separate soaking tub, dual vanity, and an impressive walk-in closet. A versatile loft/office opens to a private balcony overlooking the front yard—an ideal space for working from home, relaxing, or enjoying your morning coffee. Could also be used as a 4th bedroom. 

Outside, the drought-tolerant backyard offers easy maintenance along with in-ground garden beds ready for vegetables, herbs, or flowers. The home is also equipped with EV charging, and major appliances—including the refrigerator, dishwasher, washer, and dryer—are included.

One of the home's greatest advantages is its location within Harveston. Just a short walk away is the community's signature lake, where residents can enjoy fishing, paddle boating, and the surrounding walking path. Harveston amenities also include a clubhouse, pool, splash pad, sports park, children's parks, and neighborhood events throughout the year. Ysabel Barnett Elementary is conveniently located nearby, adding to the appeal of this well-connected community.

With Trader Joe's, Sprouts, Target, Promenade Temecula, dining, recreation, schools, and the 15 freeway all just minutes away, this home offers a wonderful combination of location, lifestyle, and community in one of Temecula's most recognizable neighborhoods.

results.remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully updated home in the golf course community of Temeku Hills where thoughtful upgrades, a versatile floor plan & resort-style amenities come together in one exceptional property. With low taxes & an unbeatable location, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style & value.
Inside, you'll find fresh interior paint, new LVP flooring throughout portions of the downstairs, shutters in select areas, elegant arched hallway doorways, a 1-year-old HVAC system, QuietCool whole house fan, an Ecobee smart thermostat & a paid solar system installed in 2020. NEM 2.0 solar allows the owner to receive credits for excess electricity sent back to Southern California Edison.
The thoughtfully designed floorplan offers the convenience of a downstairs primary suite.  A spacious downstairs en-suite bedroom also downstairs offers its own sitting area making it ideal for guests or multi-generational living.
The beautifully updated kitchen is stylish & functional, featuring stainless steel appliances, a 5-burner stove, farmhouse sink, center island with barstool seating, walk-in pantry & abundant cabinetry. Adjacent to the kitchen is the dining room creating an ideal space for everyday meals & entertaining. Just beyond, the family room offers a cozy fireplace, custom built-ins, large picture windows that fill the space with natural light & direct access to the backyard.
The newly remodeled primary bathroom is a true showpiece featuring his-and-hers closets, quartz countertops, a gorgeous walk-in shower & a modern LED lighted mirror creating a spa-like retreat you'll enjoy every day.
Upstairs, you'll find 2 additional bedrooms, a spacious loft that offers flexibility for a game room, home office or media space & a full bathroom.
Additional features include a downstairs laundry room with cabinetry, overhead garage storage racks & a Tesla charger.
Beyond the home itself, you'll enjoy the incredible lifestyle that comes with living in Temeku Hills. Residents have access to resort-style amenities including a clubhouse, heated pool/spa, fitness center, tennis & pickleball courts, game room, ballroom, playground & year-round events. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the beautiful Legends Golf Club, an 18-hole public course located within the community. Conveniently located near Temecula Wine Country, Old Town Temecula, shopping, dining, top-rated schools & freeway access, Temeku Hills remains one of Temecula's most sought-after communities.

Homes in Harveston combine lakeside living with one of the most convenient locations in Southwest Riverside County. Reach out to schedule a private showing of this Harveston pool home in Temecula, CA 92591.

results.remarks: Beautiful single story home located amidst the peace and quiet of Spanish Hills Ranchos.  Sitting on almost five acres this home offers a spacious single story floor plan with an abundance of room for entertaining or relaxing while enjoying the sweeping panoramic views.  Located adjacent to Temecula Wine Country you experience the feeling of living in wide open spaces while still being close enough to vibrant Temecula.  The home has an open feel with an inviting entryway with a spacious family room and separate dining room.  The kitchen has tasteful white cabinetry and a center island providing plenty of cabinet and counter space.  The primary bedroom suite opens directly onto the oversized attached deck where you can enjoy the private spa the cool evening breezes and magnificent star-filled skies at night.  The primary bathroom includes a soaker tub, walk-in shower and walk-in closet.  There are three additional bedrooms and 2 baths.  The large custom deck is partially covered and in addition to the spa there is a BBQ and putting green.  The low maintenance yard includes synthetic grass.  Save on your electric bills with fully owned solar.  The 360 degree yard wraps entirely around the home and features vinyl fencing and landscape irrigation.  Entering onto the property there is a 20 foot iron gate with the driveway leading to a detached garage and approach to the home.  The home is on a permanent foundation and is on septic, well and propane which is common to this equestrian community.   The property offers the option of short term rentals and sits outside of the Temecula Wine Country Plan zone.  Come on out for a visit and see what Spanish Hills Ranchos has to offer!

Meticulously maintained by its original owner, this 2,293-square-foot home represents a rare standout opportunity in Temecula. Best of all, you will enjoy true freedom with No HOA control & the Financial Perks of NO monthly HOA dues, plus remarkably LOW Property Taxes! The thoughtfully designed floor plan features an expansive 3-car garage and a highly desirable main-floor bedroom and full bath, which currently serves as a perfect home office or den. Separate, formal living and dining areas create excellent space for everyday living and entertaining. At the heart of the home, a beautifully upgraded kitchen boasts premium quartz countertops and flows seamlessly into a warm, inviting family room centered around a cozy fireplace. Upstairs, the large primary suite serves as a true sanctuary, featuring its own cozy fireplace and a spacious private bathroom complete with dual vanities, a deep soaking tub, a separate shower, and an expansive closet. It is the ultimate space for relaxing evenings or entertaining guests, complete with a sparkling spa featuring a soothing waterfall and a custom-built stone fireplace. With the elevated setting and single story homes behind, you will enjoy privacy along with soothing views and beautiful sunsets! Ideally situated in one of Temecula’s most sought-after areas, this home places you just minutes from world-class Wine Country, top-rated schools, premium shopping, and diverse dining. Commuters will also appreciate the quick, convenient freeway access, making this private, scenic, and cost-effective property a truly unbeatable opportunity.

results.remarks: Rarely does a home offer this combination of privacy, views and location. Located within the award winning Temecula Valley School District and close to Temecula Wine Country, Old Town Temecula, Championship Golf, Pechanga Resort & Casino and premier shopping and dining. Privacy, stunning views, versatile spaces, and an unbeatable location! This is South Temecula living at its finest.

results.remarks: NEED A TURNKEY HOME NOW? Welcome to 45550 Seagull Way, a beautifully maintained Wolf Creek home in South Temecula offering proximity to some of the area’s most enjoyed destinations. Set on a corner lot with inviting curb appeal, freshly kept landscaping, new exterior paint, and an open-concept layout, this home creates an easy flow for entertaining, and everyday living. Inside, the main level features new wide-plank luxury vinyl flooring and a convenient downstairs bedroom with a full bathroom, ideal for guests, extended stays, a home office, or multi-generational living. Continue through the entry to the formal dining area, then into the kitchen, where upgraded cabinetry, granite countertops, and an open connection to the spacious family room make the heart of the home feel functional. Upstairs, 2 secondary bedrooms each feature their own full bath and walk-in closet, creating a private suite-style layout. The expansive primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and generous walk-in closet. The backyard has been thoughtfully enhanced with new concrete work in the back and side yards, new landscaping, and two new Alumawood patio covers that create comfortable shaded areas. The backyard also includes gas plumbing for a future spa, offering added flexibility for outdoor living. Enjoy apple, peach, lemon, orange, lime, and a mature fig tree, plus grape vines along the side yard. The storage shed and lawn mower are included, along with the washer and dryer. The grill is also included, and the refrigerator may be negotiable… Wolf Creek residents enjoy access to amenities including a pool, spa, gym, parks, walking trails, and more. The home is also near Pechanga Resort Casino, offering dining, entertainment, and seasonal events (think 4th of July fireworks celebration.) Birdsall Sports Park provides fields and facilities for a variety of sports and community activities, while the 15 Freeway is just a few minutes away for convenient regional access. Great Oak High School is the assigned high school. +/-2,847 sq ft, 4 bedrooms, 4 total baths, a 3-car tandem attached garage, low HOA, and a 6,098 sq ft lot. Wolf Creek offers exceptional value in Temecula, combining resort-style community amenities, including a pool and community center. Best of all, residents enjoy these amenities with an exceptionally low HOA fee of approximately $55 per month (fee subject to change.) This is South Temecula living, at its finest.

Step inside to a bright and welcoming floor plan filled with natural light and inviting living spaces. results.remarks: GOLF COURSE LIVING AT ITS BEST IN TEMEKU HILLS! Welcome to this exceptional 2,724 sq. ft. home in the highly sought-after Temeku Hills community, ideally positioned on a quiet cul-de-sac with beautiful views of the 13th fairway. With a highly desirable main-level primary suite and office, this home offers the convenience of single-level living while providing the added flexibility of a second floor with two additional bedrooms and an expansive loft. Step inside to a bright, open floor plan with new carpet, neutral tones, and spacious living areas. A private office and convenient half bath are located at the front of the home, flowing into the formal living and dining rooms and continuing into the spacious kitchen and family room. The kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, a center island, stainless steel appliances, refrigerator, and walk-in pantry, making it both functional and inviting. Just beyond, the family room features a cozy fireplace and large windows that perfectly frame the spectacular golf course backdrop. The main-level primary suite is a true retreat, featuring two spacious walk-in closets, dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate walk-in shower. Upstairs, the oversized loft provides incredible flexibility as a second family room, media room, game room, or additional gathering space. Two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level. Step outside and enjoy the best part of golf course living. The low-maintenance backyard and expansive covered patio spanning the full width of the home create the perfect setting for morning coffee, evening sunsets, or entertaining while taking in the peaceful views of the 13th hole. Temeku Hills offers some of Temecula's finest amenities, including a resort-style pool, tennis and pickleball courts, sports courts, fitness facilities, and an active calendar of community events and clubs. Conveniently located near Temecula's renowned wineries, shopping, dining, entertainment, golf, and top-rated schools. Low taxes and NO Mello-Roos make this an even more attractive opportunity. Main-level living. Golf course views. Cul-de-sac location. Exceptional community amenities. This is a special home in a truly desirable Temecula neighborhood—and one you'll want to see in person.!

Upon entering, you’ll find a convenient downstairs bedroom situated on the left, along with a full bathroom—ideal for guests, family members, or a home office. The open and inviting layout creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout the home.

Upstairs, you’ll find the remaining three bedrooms, including the spacious primary suite featuring a generously sized walk-in closet. The second and third bedrooms share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, providing both functionality and privacy.

The attached two-car garage offers added convenience and storage, along with upgraded electrical outlets ready for an EV charger with a Sunrun Solar Lease.

Beautiful Single-Story Home in Desirable Morgan Hill

Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home nestled in the highly desirable Morgan Hill community of South Temecula. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, this inviting residence offers an exceptional combination of comfort, elegance, and resort-style living.

Inside, you'll appreciate the timeless details throughout, including crown molding and plantation shutters, creating a warm and sophisticated atmosphere. The thoughtfully designed single-level floor plan offers comfortable living spaces and effortless everyday convenience. Lovely open floor plan living area with a spacious kitchen with generous counter and cabinet space.

Step outside to your own private garden retreat, where a soothing fountain creates a peaceful backdrop for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The backyard is designed for easy entertaining, featuring a lovely covered patio, BBQ grill and attractive low-maintenance landscaping—perfect for hosting family and friends without the upkeep.

Additional highlights include a convenient dedicated laundry room with a deep utility sink, plus built-in cabinetry in the garage providing excellent storage and organization.

As a resident of Morgan Hill, you'll enjoy an outstanding resort-style lifestyle with access to the community's clubhouse, swimming pool, fitness center, and tennis courts. The community is also located within the highly regarded Temecula school system, including Great Oak High School.

From its peaceful cul-de-sac setting and beautifully maintained interior to its tranquil backyard and exceptional community amenities, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and resort-style Southern California living.

Don't miss the opportunity to make this special Morgan Hill home your own!

LOCATION!! LOCATION!! LOCATION!!
Located in the heart of Temecula’s renowned Wine Country, this beautifully renovated two-story residence sits on 2.5 acres of usable land and offers exceptional privacy, versatility, and scenic surroundings. Just minutes from acclaimed wineries, the property presents an outstanding opportunity for residential living, investment, or future expansion, including potential for Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs).The property also offers the potential for enhanced accessibility, with a interior Stilz Home Lift / Elevator being considered as an option for those who prefer not to navigate the stairs. 
The home features three generously sized bedrooms, three bathrooms, and approximately 2,182 square feet of thoughtfully updated living space. Recent renovations include a new roof, fresh exterior paint, new interior windows and sliding glass doors, updated laminate flooring throughout, a solar energy system, and a newer septic system. Central air conditioning, along with a newly installed upstairs split system, provides year-round comfort.
The expansive grounds offer designated RV parking, approximately 200 producing Valencia orange trees, and panoramic views of the surrounding vineyards and rolling hills. Outdoor amenities include an above-ground pool, a Jacuzzi, and a spacious wraparound upper deck, ideal for relaxation and entertaining while enjoying the serene Wine Country setting.
Zoned for flexibility, the property is approved for horse use, qualifies for an agricultural water rate discount, and offers ample space for the development of one or more ADUs—ideal for extended family accommodations, guest housing, or rental income.
Ideally situated near Wine Country’s premier tasting rooms, dining, and events, this exceptional property is well-suited as a primary residence, weekend retreat, or income-producing investment. Offering a rare combination of location, land, and upgrades, this home represents a unique opportunity in one of Temecula Wine Country’s most desirable areas.

results.remarks: Welcome to a home where everyday living feels like a private resort. Nestled in one of Temecula's desirable neighborhoods of Serena Hills, this property is a rare combination of thoughtful upgrades & timeless design. Step inside to soaring ceilings & an abundance of natural light that fill the home with a bright, open & inviting ambiance, together with custom woodwork at the stairway, elegant travertine flooring from the entry through the living & family rooms & into the beautiful kitchen, which showcases granite countertops with matching backsplash, gas stove & stainless steel refrigerator. Adding to the home's versatility, the main level features a convenient bedroom & full bathroom—ideal for guests or multi-generational living. The inviting living room is further enhanced with built-in speakers, creating the perfect ambiance for entertaining. Property has a tankless water heater, water filtration system, a built-in sub-zero fridge in the garage along with electric vehicle outlet & epoxy floors, and leased solar.  The true showpiece of this property lies beyond the back door. A significant investment, along with love and attention has been invested in creating a breathtaking tropical paradise filled with mature landscaping, lush gardens, fruit trees (pomelo, plum, pear & banana), winding pathways that lead to a clubhouse & another seating area & multiple outdoor living spaces that evoke the feeling of a luxury resort. Whether you're hosting friends, enjoying your morning coffee surrounded by vibrant greenery, or unwinding after a long day, this backyard offers an unmatched sense of tranquility & privacy rarely found in today's market. If you've been searching for a property that offers more than just square footage—a home with character, exceptional outdoor living, & an unforgettable lifestyle—this beautiful home is a rare opportunity you won't want to miss!

results.remarks: Located in the highly desirable community of Paloma Del Sol in South Temecula, this beautiful home combines comfort, space, and an ideal location. Featuring stylish laminate flooring, tile, neutral paint tones, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances, the home is both modern and inviting. The home sits on an outside corner lot, the property enjoys a generously sized side yard, along with convenient access to a nearby pathway leading directly to one of the community pools—just steps away. The home also backs to a peaceful common area, providing added privacy and access to walking trails and parks. The spacious kitchen is a standout, complete with a large center island, abundant cabinet storage, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. It opens seamlessly to a generous family room featuring a cozy fireplace and a built-in desk area—perfect for work or study. The main floor includes a spacious living room, a bedroom, a half bathroom, and a dedicated laundry room, offering flexibility and convenience for guests or multi-generational living. Upstairs: primary suite features beautiful views and an ensuite bathroom, a separate shower and soaking tub, dual sinks, a private toilet room, and a large walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the upper level. This home combines comfort, functionality, and an unbeatable location within a vibrant and amenity-rich community. This home is conveniently close to shopping, dining, entertainment, schools, and just minutes from award winning Temecula Wine Country. Temecula is one of Southern California's most desirable places to live.

results.remarks: First time on the market but not for, this home presents a rare opportunity within Temecula’s sought-after guard-gated Roripaugh Ranch community. Thoughtfully maintained & improved over the years, this single family residence combines comfortable everyday living with the privacy, amenities, & lifestyle that make Roripaugh Ranch so desirable.  Inside, the home feels bright & welcoming with fresh interior paint, upgraded padded carpeting selected by the original owner, plantation shutters throughout, & ceiling fans for added comfort. The well-designed floor plan offers inviting living spaces with an easy flow for both everyday living & entertaining.  Important improvements add lasting value, including five fully paid & owned solar panels & newer rubberized exterior stucco. Outside, an Alumawood patio extends the living space & provides a comfortable setting for relaxing, dining, & entertaining. A three-car garage provides additional parking, storage, & flexibility.  And then there’s the Roripaugh Ranch lifestyle. Behind the guard gates, residents enjoy an impressive collection of resort-style amenities including a clubhouse, swimming pool & spa, 24-hour fitness center, pickleball & tennis courts, basketball courts, central park, children's playgrounds, walking trails, landscaped green spaces, & community gathering areas.  Lovingly cared for by its original owner and never before offered on the resale market, this home brings together single-story living, paid solar, a three-car garage, thoughtful improvements, and one of Temecula’s most amenity-rich gated communities.

 Approximately 2,065 square feet of living space, and a 5,227 square foot lot. This home offers a comfortable open floor plan, neutral colors and plenty of thoughtful details throughout. 
 Step inside to rich wood floors with a custom medallion in the entryway and a beautiful mix of tile plank and carpet throughout. 
The cook's kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a built in stove, recessed lighting, plenty of cabinet space and a casual eat-in nook. Welcoming family room with a cozy gas fireplace, cool ceiling fan, custom window coverings, newer central heating and air unit and leased solar system.  Living in Temeku Hills means enjoying a fantastic community with many amenities that include an executive clubhouse complete with pool, spa, tennis and pickleball courts, private kids playground, workout gym/exercise room, card room, meeting room. All within your own community. 
The high end Temeku Golf course is open to the public, close to schools, medical, shopping, parks, wineries, Old Town Temecula and freeways. This home features 13 solar panels on a 25 year Power Purchase Agreement with Sunrun.

results.remarks:
Seller is offering a rate buy down, credit for closing costs- Buyers may save hundreds per month! 
Welcome to this beautifully upgraded, 2,141-square-foot Temeku Hills home sitting on a private 5,662-square-foot lot and featuring a highly coveted, fully PAID SOLAR system. Move-in ready with neutral paint, newer luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring, and upscale plantation-type shutters throughout, this 5-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom property delivers the perfect blend of modern comfort and master-planned community living.Step inside to high ceilings and an abundance of natural light flowing through the formal living and dining room, which features elegant crown molding. The main level also hosts a versatile fifth bedroom currently used as an ideal den or office ( no closet) , a convenient half-bathroom, updated baseboards, and bright new recessed lighting. The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen, which overlooks the cozy family room with its fireplace and media nook. The kitchen boasts light grey painted cabinets with stainless hardware, an eat-at island, a walk-in pantry, and updated KitchenAid stainless steel appliances, including the microwave and dishwasher.Upstairs, you will find newer LVP flooring throughout, with the only carpet in the entire home located on the stairs. The spacious primary suite serves as a true retreat, offering a bright en-suite bathroom with dual sinks, updated hardware and light fixtures, painted cabinets, a soaking tub, and a separate walk-in shower with a new glass enclosure. It also features a great walk-in closet with premium custom built-in hanging and storage systems. The three secondary bedrooms on this level all include ceiling fans, and one offers a walk-in closet with built-in features. The secondary bathroom is highly functional with dual sinks, painted cabinets, updated hardware, and a separate tub and shower combination. For ultimate convenience, the laundry room is located upstairs. The exterior features a three-car tandem garage packed with built-in storage and a handy side door leading to the backyard. The private outdoor space offers a concrete patio, a green grass area, and plenty of privacy for relaxing or entertaining. Located in a highly desirable low-tax area, this home grants access to the incredible amenities of the Temeku Hills master-planned community. It is situated within an award-winning school district and is just minutes from major freeways, shopping, and the world-renowned Temecula Wine Country.
